hooks.name: Block KILOMBO typo
hooks.description: Catch and prevent the typo KILOMBO (should be KILOMBO) in any command or code edit

action.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Block any instance of 'KILOMBO' (case-insensitive) — it should always be 'KILOMBO'
if echo "$1" | grep -qi 'KILOMBO'; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"🚫 TYPO DETECTED: 'KILOMBO' appears in this operation. The correct spelling is KILOMBO. This typo was intentionally removed from the entire project. Please correct it before proceeding."}}'
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
